notes_review: Sound: the §7 glosses are placed at genuine first technical uses, "capital", "surplus-value" and "hoard" are rightly left to Marx's own definitions, and the retranslations of Pinto, Genovesi, Say and Sismondi follow the foreign text literally as §2.3 requires; the borderline money-form gloss in p021 does not contradict the text.
summary: Faithful: the C—M—C / M—C—M comparison, the derivation of surplus-value as increment, the miser/capitalist contrast and the Trinitarian image all keep their steps, formulas and irony. Clear plain English at the target reading level.
